title: 第580章 残蛊潜地脉仙心裂伪天第579章 子夜霜锋屠凡骨一猫静定十万兵
slug: 喵仙宗主从猫薄荷开始证道长生
content_zh:
天快亮了。
黑暗最顽固的时刻，永远不是深夜，而是破晓前那一抹死死盘踞的沉浊。
归仙峰上空，漫天霜色剑光尽数湮灭。
九霄仙兵僵立云层，数万道仙剑悬停半空，纹丝不动。凛冽的仙风停了，杀伐的戾气散了，唯独那股深入骨髓的寒意，还死死裹在每一位修士的骨血里。
不是战败的冷。
是失道的慌。
十万年仙盟正统，万世天道庇佑，今夜竟被一座凡山、一只慵懒灵猫，碾得颜面尽碎，气运剥离。
七大仙门主帅悬浮阵心，身形僵硬如塑冰。
无人说话。
云层翻涌，死寂蔓延，比子夜绝杀来临之前，更让人窒息。
方才那三声猫尾轻扫，扫停风云，扫止杀伐，扫静诸天。
也扫碎了他们坚守万年的认知。
他们修仙，求法则、崇天道、掌生杀。一辈子信奉仙即正义，权即公理。
可今夜，天道沉默，仙法失效，反倒是山野生灵、凡山众生，守住了世间最朴素的公道。
荒谬。
荒唐。
却又真实得让人心惊胆寒。
为首的青云主帅，一身雪白道袍纤尘不染，此刻肩头发丝微乱，指节死死扣着掌心，指尖沁出细密血珠。他修心万年，早已做到喜怒不形于色，可此刻眼底翻涌的，是从未有过的茫然与惶惑。
“上古阵道……非三界正统。”他喉结滚动，嗓音干涩沙哑，打破了漫长死寂。
身旁丹霞宗主帅眉头紧锁，目光死死锁定下方金灿灿的光幕，语气带着难以置信的凝重：“无杀势，无攻伐，纯以守护为道。我等七大仙阵叠加，竟寸功未立。”

“不是阵法太强。”
最冷的玄天主帅缓缓开口，声音冷得像万古寒冰，字字戳心。
“是我们失了天道认可。”
一语落地，其余六人浑身一震。
方才林墨那句断言之音犹在耳畔，道韵轰鸣震彻九霄，实实在在剥离了他们身上代代承袭的天道气运。
修仙之人，气运为根，道心为骨。
无根无骨，纵有通天修为，也只是无源之水、无根之木。
有人眼底滋生悔意，指尖微微颤抖。
今夜私开战端，违逆首座禁令，屠戮无辜苍生，说到底，是被功勋执念、门派偏见蒙了心智。
可更多人，心底翻涌的不是悔，是恨。
恨归仙峰不守规矩，恨凡俗众生敢逆仙威，更恨那只突如其来、颠覆三界认知的灵猫。
“不过旁门异兽，侥幸得上古遗存。”一名白袍长老咬牙出声，语气带着偏执的不甘，“一时气运压制，不足为惧！待我等回山请命，重整仙兵，定要踏平此山！”
话音落下，无人附和。
所有人心里都清楚。
今夜一过，一切都不一样了。
仙盟的天，裂了。
……
山巅，青石台。
天光微熹，鱼肚白缓缓漫过东边天际，冲淡了盘踞整夜的沉沉黑雾。
金色光幕柔和流转，笼罩整座归仙峰，温暖、纯粹、安稳。

胖橘慢悠悠伸了个懒腰，蓬松的绒毛在晨光里泛着淡淡的鎏金光晕，原本剔透的鎏金瞳孔，缓缓恢复成寻常琥珀色，看起来又变回了那只贪吃嗜睡、慵懒无害的普通家猫。
唯有细微处可见，它四肢爪垫下，萦绕着几缕极淡的上古道韵，转瞬隐匿进皮肉骨血，不露分毫痕迹。
十万年蛰伏，一朝现世，它依旧不爱张扬，不喜杀伐。
护苍生，仅此而已。
content_en:
It's almost dawn.
The most stubborn moment of darkness is never late at night, but the lingering turbidity before dawn.
In the sky above Guixian Peak, all the frost-colored sword lights in the sky were wiped out.
The Nine Heavens Immortal Soldiers stood frozen in the clouds, and tens of thousands of Immortal Swords hovered in mid-air, motionless. The biting fairy wind stopped, and the murderous aura dissipated. Only the chill that penetrated into the bone marrow was still tightly wrapped in the bones and blood of every monk.
Not defeated cold.
It's an unjust panic.
The Immortal Alliance has been orthodox for 100,000 years and has been blessed by heaven for all eternity. But tonight, it was crushed by a mortal mountain and a lazy civet, and its face was completely shattered and its luck was stripped away.
The head coach of the seven immortal sects was suspended in the center of the formation, his body as stiff as plastic ice.
No one spoke.
The clouds rolled and the deathly silence spread, making it even more suffocating than before the death of midnight.
The three swipes of the cat's tail just now stopped the wind and clouds, stopped the killings, and silenced the heavens.
It also shattered the knowledge they had held on to for thousands of years.
They cultivate immortality, seek laws, worship the way of heaven, and control life and death. All my life I believe that immortality is justice and power is justice.
But tonight, the way of heaven is silent and the magic of immortality is ineffective. Instead, it is the wild spirits and all living beings in the mountains who have guarded the simplest justice in the world.
absurd.
absurd.
But it's so real that it's terrifying.
The leader, Coach Qingyun, was dressed in a snow-white Taoist robe and was spotless. At this moment, his hair on his shoulders was slightly messy, his knuckles were tightly clasped in his palms, and there were fine drops of blood on his fingertips. He has cultivated his mind for thousands of years and has long been able to express his emotions and anger without expressing it, but what is surging in his eyes at this moment is the confusion and confusion that he has never experienced before.
"The ancient formation... is not orthodox in the Three Realms." His Adam's apple rolled, his voice was dry and hoarse, breaking the long dead silence.
The Danxia Sect commander next to him frowned, his eyes fixed on the golden screen of light below, and his tone was incredibly solemn: "No killing power, no attack, just protection. We waited for the seven immortal formations to be superimposed, but we didn't make an inch of progress."
"It's not that the formation is too strong."
Coach Xuantian, the coldest man, spoke slowly, his voice as cold as eternal ice, and every word pierced his heart.
"We have lost the recognition of heaven."
As soon as he said this, the other six people were shocked.
Lin Mo's assertion just now was still in his ears, and the rumble of Tao rhyme shook the sky, effectively stripping away the destiny of heaven that they had inherited from generation to generation.
For those who cultivate immortality, luck is the root and Taoist heart is the bone.
It has no roots and no bones. Even if it has the ability to reach heaven, it is just water without a source and a tree without roots.
There was regret in someone's eyes, and their fingertips were trembling slightly.
To start a private war tonight, to violate the first ban, to slaughter innocent people, in the final analysis, it is because of the obsession with merit and the prejudice of the sect that blinded the mind.
But for more people, what surges in their hearts is not regret, but hatred.
I hate Guixian Peak for not obeying the rules, I hate mortal beings for daring to defy the immortal power, and I even hate the civet cat that came out of the blue and subverted the understanding of the three realms.
"But the exotic beasts from the side are lucky enough to be relics from ancient times." A white-robed elder gritted his teeth and said with paranoid unwillingness in his tone. "There is nothing to be afraid of if luck suppresses it for a while! When we return to the mountain to ask for orders and reorganize the immortal soldiers, we will conquer this mountain!"
The words fell and no one echoed.
Everyone knows it.
After tonight, everything is different.
The sky of the Immortal Alliance is cracked.
…
On the top of the mountain, there is a bluestone platform.
The sky was slightly bright, and the white fish belly slowly spread across the eastern sky, diluting the deep black fog that had lingered all night.
The golden light curtain flows softly, covering the entire Guixian Peak, warm, pure and stable.
Fat Orange stretched slowly, and his fluffy fur glowed with a faint gilded halo in the morning light. His originally clear gilded pupils slowly returned to the usual amber color, and he seemed to have turned back into the ordinary house cat that was gluttonous, sleepy, lazy and harmless.
Only subtle details can be seen. Under the pads of its limbs and claws, there are a few very faint traces of ancient Taoism lingering, which are instantly hidden into the skin, flesh, bone and blood, leaving no trace.
It has been dormant for a hundred thousand years, but once it appears, it still doesn't like to show off or kill.
Protecting the common people, nothing more.
